content:
It’s never okay to say something intentionally harmful when ending a relationship. Instead, be honest but kind—focus on your feelings and needs without blame. For example:

*"I care about you, but I need to move on for my own well-being. This isn’t easy, but it’s what’s best for me."*

Hurtful words only cause lasting pain. Choose respect.
